what: Append-only supplement for SL-5: the rest of the lines someone says (VL-2). Every battle telegraph at every tier, with the names the code can put in (a creature's, a companion's; a line with the player's own name cannot be recorded), and the solo wordings for a move at both (RBN-QA-003) (code.battle); what people say in an encounter, your social lines, its conclusions (code.enc); the companion's reply kept with a Shared memory; the hanafuda calls (code.hanafuda); your ask-back questions (code.ask); plus anything else the script gained since SL4.
authorization: Robin, 2026-10-20: 'Create the relevant missing voice lines and ensure they're pushed live. If something isn't set up to be spoken yet, explain why and find a proper way to resolve it completely, from the initial plan, system, voice generation and implementation to pushing live. Coordinate with the local agent entirely.' Local's batch continues unchanged; these are new recordings appended after it, with the same cast, engines and gates.

builtFrom.command: node tools/voice/supplement.mjs --id SL5 (tools/voice/production_manifest.mjs into a scratch directory, compared by id with the GO manifest and the earlier supplements)
